scenes.anchor: the black-mullion glass pivot front door of a Scandinavian-modern blackened-cedar-clad residence
scenes.justification: A bilateral pivot front door framed by blackened-cedar pilasters is the canonical centerline anchor for flanking — and a slim 12-inch vertical linear bar matched to the tall narrow door reveal is exactly what a hospitality lighting designer would spec for this elevation.

A low strip of charcoal river-rock runs along the foundation. Inside the door, a warm amber glow from a walnut-and-brass interior reads softly through the smoked glass. scenes.justification: A long uninterrupted slatted-cedar fence beside a rectilinear pool is the textbook linear plane — three vertical linear bars at equal intervals at the same mounting height define zonal path-marking along the pool deck and read as architectural lighting design, not clutter.
